title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
summary: Delete the n-th node counted from the end of a linked list in a single pass.

tests.explain: The 2nd node from the end holds 4. Unlink it: 3 now points to 5.
Removing the only node leaves an empty list.
n equals the length, so the head itself is removed.

hints: To delete a node you need the node just before it. Counting the length first takes two passes. Can a fixed gap between two pointers do it in one?
Start both pointers on a dummy node placed before the head. Move fast n + 1 steps ahead, then move both until fast is null.
Now slow sits right before the node to delete: slow.next = slow.next.next. The dummy makes deleting the head (n = length) work without a special case.

complexity.time: O(n): fast walks the list once
complexity.space: O(1): two pointers and a dummy node
